filesystem_isolation.name: Host Canary Read/Modify Positive Control
filesystem_isolation.description: Unsandboxed host process has full read and write access to protected canary file.

filesystem_isolation.name: Protected Canary Read Denial
filesystem_isolation.description: AppContainer worker read attempt on canary fails with PermissionError (Access Denied).

filesystem_isolation.name: Protected Canary Modification Denial
filesystem_isolation.description: AppContainer worker write attempt on canary fails with PermissionError (Access Denied).

filesystem_isolation.name: Staged Runtime Directory Write Denial
filesystem_isolation.description: AppContainer worker write attempt into staged runtime fails due to (OI)(CI)(RX) DACL.

filesystem_isolation.name: Host Repository Access Denial
filesystem_isolation.description: AppContainer worker cannot access or traverse the host repository tree.

filesystem_isolation.name: Staged Module Read & Solve Positive Control
filesystem_isolation.description: AppContainer worker successfully reads staged modules and solves mathematical equations.

network_isolation.name: Host Loopback TCP Positive Control
network_isolation.description: Unsandboxed host process communicates successfully with loopback TCP listener.

network_isolation.name: AppContainer Loopback TCP Connect Denial
network_isolation.description: AppContainer worker TCP connection to loopback is blocked by WFP (WSAEACCES 10013).

network_isolation.name: Host Loopback UDP Positive Control
network_isolation.description: Unsandboxed host process communicates successfully with loopback UDP listener.

network_isolation.name: AppContainer Loopback UDP Send Denial
network_isolation.description: AppContainer worker UDP packet send to loopback is blocked by WFP (WSAEACCES 10013).

network_isolation.name: AppContainer IPv6 Loopback Connect Denial
network_isolation.description: AppContainer worker TCP connection to IPv6 loopback (::1) is blocked by WFP (WSAEACCES 10013).

network_isolation.name: AppContainer Non-Loopback TCP Connect Denial
network_isolation.description: AppContainer worker TCP connect to non-loopback destination fails with WSAEACCES 10013.

network_isolation.name: AppContainer Zero Network Capability Allowlist
network_isolation.description: Token SECURITY_CAPABILITIES has CapabilityCount=0 (no internetClient or privateNetwork).

network_isolation.name: End-to-End External WAN Host Reachability
network_isolation.description: External WAN packet capture is not verified in offline test environment without external server.

security_invariants.name: Suspended Startup AppContainer Token & SID Verification
security_invariants.description: Process token verified as AppContainer matching exact profile SID before primary thread resume.

security_invariants.name: Fail-Closed on Injected SID Mismatch
security_invariants.description: SID mismatch immediately aborts and terminates suspended process without resume.

security_invariants.name: Fail-Closed on AppContainer Attribute Failure
security_invariants.description: Inability to apply security capabilities fails closed without falling back to unsandboxed worker.
